newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-DORTMUND'S SAMMER TO MISS CUP SEMIFINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DORTMUND'S SAMMER TO MISS CUP SEMIFINAL.

text.p: Libero Matthias Sammer will miss Borussia Dortmund's European Cup semifinal second leg clash against Manchester United on Wednesday, coach Ottmar Hitzfeld said on Sunday.

Sammer, 29, recovering from a ruptured thigh muscle, has only played 13 out of 28 matches in the Bundesliga German first division and four out of nine games in the European Cup this season due to injuries and suspension.
"We will do everything we can to get him fit again," said Hitzfeld. "He is still Germany's best footballer".
The German champions take a goal advantage into the second leg after their home leg earlier this month.
